Greenbelt center that operates Hubble and many Earth and space science missions.

How Goddard Space Flight Center connects

  • Topic: NASA — Goddard is NASA's Greenbelt science-operations center.
  • Item: Hubble Space Telescope — Goddard operates Hubble as NASA's science-operations center.

What is Goddard Space Flight Center?

Goddard in Maryland is NASA's science-operations hub for Hubble, Earth observatories, and a large share of unmanned astrophysics flight software.
